recipe.name: nvfp4
recipe.description: NVFP4 weights (e2m1, group 16, e4m3 block scales, one fp32 global scale per tensor, per expert for the fused expert tensors); activations stay bf16 (W4A16). No data needed.

calibration.method: GPTQ with static NVFP4 scales and static act-order (G1-lite)
calibration.decision: D1: block scales and per-expert global scales equal the data-free N2 ones; only codes change

solver.algorithm: GPTQ, static NVFP4 scales (decision D1), static act-order, no g_idx
